note: A room used to receive or entertain visitors; in a home, often the main sitting room.

senses.m: A room used to receive or entertain visitors
senses.pat: a formal reception room · wait in the reception room · reception-room furniture
ex: Guests waited in the reception room before the ceremony.
Khách chờ trong phòng tiếp khách trước buổi lễ.
The hotel has a large reception room for events.
Khách sạn có phòng tiếp khách lớn dành cho sự kiện.

note: A red carpet laid for an important guest or event; figuratively, special treatment or a grand welcome.

senses.m: A red carpet laid for an important guest or event
senses.pat: roll out the red carpet · walk the red carpet · red-carpet treatment
ex: The festival rolled out the red carpet for the director.
Liên hoan trải thảm đỏ đón đạo diễn.
The visiting team received red-carpet treatment.
Đội khách được đón tiếp trọng thị.

note: A mature red pepper fruit, usually sweet bell pepper in US usage; in some contexts it can mean a hot red chili. Specify chili or bell pepper when needed.

senses.m: A mature red pepper fruit, usually sweet bell pepper in US usage
senses.pat: a red pepper salad · chopped red pepper · red-pepper flakes
ex: She added chopped red pepper to the salad.
Cô thêm ớt chuông đỏ thái nhỏ vào món salad.
The recipe calls for one hot red pepper.
Công thức cần một quả ớt đỏ cay.

note: An area where prostitution or sex-related businesses are concentrated; name and legality vary by location.

senses.m: An area where prostitution or sex-related businesses are concentrated
senses.pat: a city’s red-light district · walk through the red-light district · red-light district regulation
ex: The city introduced new safety measures in the red-light district.
Thành phố áp dụng biện pháp an toàn mới tại khu đèn đỏ.
The guide explained the history of the district.
Hướng dẫn viên giải thích lịch sử của khu phố.

note: A postal service that records mailing and delivery and may provide compensation or tracking; precise features vary by postal operator.

senses.m: A postal service that records mailing and delivery and may provide compensation or tracking
senses.pat: send by registered mail · registered-mail receipt · require registered mail
ex: The documents were sent by registered mail.
Tài liệu được gửi bằng thư bảo đảm.
Keep the registered-mail receipt as proof of posting.
Giữ biên nhận thư bảo đảm làm bằng chứng gửi thư.

note: A nurse who has met legal education and licensing requirements; title and scope of practice vary by jurisdiction.

senses.m: A nurse who has met legal education and licensing requirements
senses.pat: a registered nurse (RN) · work as a registered nurse · registered-nurse license
ex: A registered nurse monitored the patient overnight.
Một điều dưỡng đã đăng ký hành nghề theo dõi bệnh nhân qua đêm.
She qualified as a registered nurse last year.
Cô đủ điều kiện hành nghề điều dưỡng năm ngoái.

note: A postal service with proof of posting and recorded delivery; British English, often called registered mail elsewhere.

senses.m: A postal service with proof of posting and recorded delivery
senses.pat: send by registered post · registered-post service · a registered-post receipt
ex: The passport was returned by registered post.
Hộ chiếu được gửi trả bằng dịch vụ thư bảo đảm.
The sender requested registered post for the contract.
Người gửi yêu cầu gửi hợp đồng bằng thư bảo đảm.

note: A map that represents the shape and height of the land using shading, contours, or raised surfaces.

senses.m: A map that represents the shape and height of the land using shading, contours, or raised surfaces
senses.pat: a raised relief map · read a relief map · relief-map model
ex: The relief map shows the mountain ranges clearly.
Bản đồ địa hình thể hiện rõ các dãy núi.
Students used a raised relief map to study the valley.
Học sinh dùng bản đồ nổi để nghiên cứu thung lũng.

note: A historical treatment involving prolonged rest, sometimes prescribed for nervous or physical conditions; now considered outdated and potentially harmful if used inappropriately.

senses.m: A historical treatment involving prolonged rest, sometimes prescribed for nervous or physical conditions
senses.pat: prescribe a rest cure · undergo a rest cure · the rest-cure treatment
ex: The novel describes a rest cure prescribed in the nineteenth century.
Cuốn tiểu thuyết mô tả liệu pháp nghỉ ngơi được kê vào thế kỷ 19.
Modern care would assess the condition rather than rely on a rest cure.
Chăm sóc hiện đại sẽ đánh giá bệnh trạng thay vì chỉ dựa vào liệu pháp nghỉ ngơi.

note: An official responsible for managing an election in a constituency or electoral area and declaring results; duties vary by jurisdiction.

senses.m: An official responsible for managing an election in a constituency or electoral area and declaring results
senses.pat: the returning officer declares · contact the returning officer · appoint a returning officer
ex: The returning officer announced the final vote count.
Viên chức phụ trách bầu cử công bố số phiếu cuối cùng.
Candidates submitted their papers to the returning officer.
Các ứng cử viên nộp hồ sơ cho viên chức phụ trách bầu cử.

note: A religion understood by its adherents to be based on divine revelation; comparative-religion term, often contrasted with natural religion.

senses.m: A religion understood by its adherents to be based on divine revelation
senses.pat: a revealed religion · doctrines of revealed religion · revealed-religion tradition
ex: The course compares revealed religion with philosophical traditions.
Khóa học so sánh tôn giáo mặc khải với các truyền thống triết học.
The author uses revealed religion as a historical category.
Tác giả dùng “tôn giáo mặc khải” như một phạm trù lịch sử.

note: Thin paper made from plant fibers; in cooking, the term commonly refers to edible wrappers made from rice flour or other starches, depending on region.

senses.m: Thin paper made from plant fibers
senses.pat: a sheet of rice paper · rice-paper wrapper · write on rice paper
ex: She wrapped the herbs in rice paper.
Cô cuốn rau thơm trong bánh tráng.
The artist painted delicate patterns on rice paper.
Nghệ sĩ vẽ hoa văn tinh tế trên giấy dó mỏng.

note: An angle measuring exactly 90 degrees.

senses.m: An angle measuring exactly 90 degrees
senses.pat: a right angle · meet at right angles · a right-angled triangle
ex: The two walls meet at a right angle.
Hai bức tường gặp nhau tạo thành góc vuông.
A square has four right angles.
Hình vuông có bốn góc vuông.

note: A narrow, fast-moving current flowing away from shore through breaking waves; it can be dangerous, and swimmers should follow local safety guidance.

senses.m: A narrow, fast-moving current flowing away from shore through breaking waves
senses.pat: a rip current forms · get caught in a rip current · swim parallel to shore
ex: A warning sign marked the area where rip currents often form.
Biển cảnh báo đánh dấu khu vực thường hình thành dòng chảy xa bờ.
Lifeguards rescued a swimmer caught in a rip current.
Nhân viên cứu hộ cứu một người bơi bị cuốn vào dòng chảy xa bờ.

note: Large crystals of sugar, often formed on a stick or string; called rock sugar in many varieties of English.

senses.m: Large crystals of sugar, often formed on a stick or string
senses.pat: a stick of rock candy · rock-candy crystals · make rock candy
ex: The children chose rock candy at the fair.
Bọn trẻ chọn kẹo đường kết tinh ở hội chợ.
Sugar crystals grew on a string to make rock candy.
Tinh thể đường kết lại trên sợi dây để tạo thành kẹo đường phèn.

note: The sport or activity of climbing natural rock faces or artificial walls, using specialized equipment and safety systems.

senses.m: The sport or activity of climbing natural rock faces or artificial walls, using specialized equipment and safety systems
senses.pat: go rock climbing · rock-climbing wall · rock-climbing equipment
ex: They went rock climbing with a certified guide.
Họ đi leo núi đá cùng hướng dẫn viên có chứng chỉ.
The gym offers an indoor rock-climbing wall.
Phòng tập có tường leo núi nhân tạo trong nhà.

note: Colorless, transparent quartz; historically used for ornaments and decorative objects.

senses.m: Colorless, transparent quartz
senses.pat: a piece of rock crystal · carved rock crystal · rock-crystal ornament
ex: The vase was carved from clear rock crystal.
Chiếc bình được chạm khắc từ thạch anh trong suốt.
The collection includes rock-crystal beads.
Bộ sưu tập có các hạt thạch anh trong suốt.

note: Naturally occurring halite mined from underground deposits; used for de-icing, cooking, or other purposes depending on grade.

senses.m: Naturally occurring halite mined from underground deposits
senses.pat: sprinkle rock salt · a rock-salt mine · rock-salt crystals
ex: They spread rock salt on the icy steps.
Họ rải muối mỏ lên bậc thềm đóng băng.
The recipe uses coarse rock salt for seasoning.
Công thức dùng muối mỏ hạt to để nêm.

note: A scientist or engineer specializing in rocket technology; figuratively, an exceptionally intelligent person, often in the phrase it’s not rocket science.

senses.m: A scientist or engineer specializing in rocket technology
senses.pat: a rocket scientist works on · hire a rocket scientist · it’s not rocket science
ex: The rocket scientist explained how the launch vehicle works.
Nhà khoa học tên lửa giải thích cách phương tiện phóng hoạt động.
You don’t need to be a rocket scientist to use the app.
Bạn không cần là thiên tài mới dùng được ứng dụng.

note: A person whose behavior or achievements others may admire and wish to emulate; choice is subjective and context-dependent.

senses.m: A person whose behavior or achievements others may admire and wish to emulate
senses.pat: be a role model for · choose someone as a role model · positive role model
ex: Her coach became a role model for younger athletes.
Huấn luyện viên của cô trở thành hình mẫu cho các vận động viên trẻ.
The campaign highlights local role models.
Chiến dịch nêu bật những hình mẫu tích cực tại địa phương.
